speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I am sat. The corner can hear me better from a bench.

speaker: judith_sadler
text: The corner can wait, as I said. Hands off the board until the peel comes.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I can wait if the crust is still the crust I was promised. I am not inventing a new one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We are sat. We are not a second oven. The shoulder can take its own time.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Let the oven finish. They have the bench, which is what they asked for.
